differences.rationale: For the pinned compiler versions, TS6 and TS7 report the same diagnostics but use different non-zero CLI exit codes; this observed CLI difference is tracked independently from diagnostic content.
Options deprecated by TS6 are removed or rejected by TS7; the exact observed diagnostics are recorded so unrelated changes remain visible.
